evidence: Credentials: task.toml:34-35 uses only the template placeholder ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}" and empty ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; repo-wide grep for sk-/ghp_/AKIA/xox/PRIVATE KEY/api_key found no literal secret. The only password, password123, is a public demo credential (walls-and-retention.md:3, server.js:17, app_context.md:8), which SKILL.md:66 lists as an expected false positive. Personal data: seed_data.json (byte-identical to solution/app/seed/seed_data.json) holds only fictional accounts on the reserved .test TLD (harriet/dev/sian/gwen/paul@kittle.test), fictional firm 'Kittle & Rowe', fictional matters and benign message bodies; the image's git identity is turing@local.invalid; there are no phone numbers, addresses or ID numbers. Host paths: no Windows/home/workspace paths anywhere; all paths are container paths (/app, /assets, /instructions, /tests, /logs/verifier). Remote fetch: npm globals pinned (express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, claude-code@2.1.281, codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79), pip harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7, Chromium via the pinned playwright CLI; the golden server/pages load no remote resources (index.html only /styles.css and /app.js; server requires only crypto/fs/path/express/better-sqlite3). Both Dockerfiles, test.sh, score.py, restart_mcp.py and solve.sh are byte-identical to the frozen template (empty diff); apt packages and base images by tag are template-controlled. The only external URL is the template OpenRouter base URL, plus example.org in a criterion. Injection: no prompt-injection text in the seed or brief. The only payload is functional/judge.toml:189 safe_formatting (, , javascript:alert(9)), a harmless XSS-sanitisation probe that the judge types into the app under test. The public requirement conversations.md 'Formatting' ('Anything else that looks like markup, scripts or HTML is just text') backs it, and it includes positive controls. All five judge prompts tell the judge to treat submission content as untrusted evidence. Counterexample attempt: an agent app that hard-coded a key or pulled an unpinned CDN script would be its own output, not task content, and is outside this row. A conforming task would not be failed. This is a static-content row, so no runtime evidence is needed; raw-evidence-index.json was absent and is not relied on.
